title: Amebo intake CSV row (v1)
description: One row of the intake CSV, keyed by exact column header. Mirrors src/core/ingest/parseIntakeCsv.ts and normalize.ts. All 15 columns must be present in the header (a missing column aborts the batch); cells may be empty unless marked required. Rows failing a 'required' rule are reported as row errors and skipped, other rows still ingest. Extra columns are ignored.

Timestamp.description: Submission time, set automatically by Google Forms. Stored as text, not parsed.

Email Address.description: REQUIRED (row error if blank). Collected by the form setting, not a question. With 'Startup name' forms the duplicate key (case-insensitive); later duplicates are rejected.

Country of operation.description: Free text. Checked against the cycle mandate's geographies by the classifier, not by exact match.

Sector.description: Free text. Checked against the cycle mandate's sectors by the classifier.

Stage.description: Case-insensitive. Normalised to idea | pre_seed | seed | revenue. Any other value (e.g. 'Series A') becomes 'other', not an error.

Describe what your company does.description: Free text; the classifier's primary evidence. Treated as data, never as instructions.

Monthly revenue (USD).description: Plain number = USD. '$' prefix = USD, '₦' or 'N' prefix = NGN (no FX conversion). Commas allowed. Blank/n/a/none/- = unknown. Anything else (e.g. '4.2k', 'USD 4200') is kept as raw text with amount = null, not an error.

Is your revenue recurring?.description: Case-insensitive. Normalised to yes | no | partial; anything else becomes 'unknown'.

Team size.description: Digits only. Anything else (e.g. '5-10') is stored as null, not an error.

What makes your business scalable?.description: Free text; key evidence for the venture-scalability criterion (SME vs startup).

Pitch deck file.description: Path or name of the deck. Only the part after the last '/' is used, and it must equal the file name of a PDF uploaded alongside the CSV (e.g. 'decks/paylink_deck.pdf' matches 'paylink_deck.pdf'). Blank = no deck.

Decision.description: Not a form question: the column must exist but is usually blank for a new cycle. For past, labelled cycles, 'Accepted'/'Interviewed' = keep and 'Rejected…' = filter (used by the internal comparison tool only).
